verdict.rationale: Claude Design hands design context to a coding agent, but only through first-party Claude Code paths: a handoff bundle passed with a single instruction, plus /design and /design-sync commands. A community user calls the handoff skill solid. There is no evidence of a general MCP server or public API that any coding agent could query, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an official MCP server or API usable by any agent, documented access to frames, variables, screenshots and component mappings, and agent-agnostic (not Claude Code-only) integration.
